fixture_registry.independence: hand authored source edge lists; CSR / inverse CSR and every expected result are derived inside the fixture package, never by OpenGraph, AccelGraph host code, or DUT functions

backpressure.policy: every stalled domain releases within its bounded period; no permanent stalls

required_scenarios: new frontier at first, middle and last in-neighbour
isolated vertex with zero inverse degree
self loop and duplicate in-edge policy
reset during edge stream and with a buffered write
wide identifier and parent toggle sweep
bfs-kernel.precision_policy: exact integer frontier byte and parent identity; the parent must be the first frontier in-neighbour in inverse CSR order

required_scenarios: zero, single and multi in-degree vertices
second iteration over the same fixture
reset during accumulation and repeat round
pagerank-kernel.precision_policy: FixedPoint and Quantized accumulate exactly and wrap modulo 2^DATA_SIZE_WRITE_BITS with no rounding and no saturation; FloatPoint accumulates IEEE-754 binary32 in stream order with one accumulator restart per vertex and a 16 cycle drain

required_scenarios: reset during accumulation and repeat round
spmv-kernel.precision_policy: FixedPoint computes (data * weight) >> SCALEF truncated to DATA_SIZE_READ_BITS then accumulates modulo 2^DATA_SIZE_WRITE_BITS: truncation toward zero, no rounding, no saturation; FloatPoint multiplies and accumulates in IEEE-754 binary32 with the documented 5 cycle multiplier alignment

required_scenarios: round boundary with a standing continue count
connected-components-kernel.precision_policy: labels are canonicalised to partitions before comparison; raw representative identifiers are never compared

required_scenarios: no triangle, single triangle, shared edge and K4 normalisation
reset during a slice and repeat round
triangle-kernel.precision_policy: exact per-vertex triangle counts; the host applies the documented normalisation of the summed per-vertex counts

required_scenarios: zero, single and burst vertex jobs
algorithm-shells.precision_policy: transaction level: vertex job acceptance, read command legality, writeback routing and completion counters

sensitivity.policy: every active context runs its declared source mutations; a mutation that still passes fails the suite
sensitivity.expected_result: mutated simulation exits nonzero with the declared diagnostic
